### `epx codex-provider`

Usage: `epx codex-provider <status|allow <id> [--yes]|revoke <id>>`

Inspect, allow or revoke custom Codex provider routing consent.

State-changing: yes. JSON mode: `none`.

Drives no management route.

| Flag | Value | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `--yes` | boolean | Explicitly approve the named provider without an interactive prompt. |

- Only local loopback routing for Responses providers using OpenAI authentication is supported. No custom credentials/headers, authless mode or client compaction. Unapproved providers are never changed.

### `epx resolve`

One JSON document naming the config home, the effective port, and the identity-checked proxy liveness verdict.

State-changing: no. JSON mode: `envelope`.

Drives no management route.

| Flag | Value | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `--json` | boolean | Emit the resolve document as JSON (the shell contract). |

- Exit 0 carries a trustworthy verdict (live or proven absent); exit 1 means the CLI could not resolve and a caller must refuse to guess — unknown liveness never reads as absent.
- Built for embedding shells (desktop app): the liveness budgets stay owned by src/server/proxy-liveness.ts.

### `epx update`

Plan or apply an EasyProxy update.

State-changing: yes. JSON mode: `envelope`.

Drives no management route.

| Flag | Value | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `--plan` | boolean | Preview an orchestrated update with --json. |
| `--yes` | boolean | Apply an orchestrated update with --json. |
| `--json` | boolean | Emit a versioned plan or result. |
| `--tag` | string | Select latest or preview for the legacy update or plan. |
| `--version` | string | Select an exact version for a plan or apply. |
| `--expect-plan` | string | Require the apply plan to match this planToken. |
| `--not-after` | string | Refuse mutation after this Unix millisecond deadline. |
| `--desktop` | boolean | Update a Windows Desktop installation headlessly (signature-verified MSI). |
| `--check` | boolean | With --desktop, report the published and serving versions without installing. |

- Orchestrated exit codes: 0 verified or up-to-date; 10 refused; 11 previous version verified; 12 uncertain; 64 usage.
- --desktop exit codes: 0 done or up to date; 1 nothing installed; 2 old runtime still serving or reboot pending; 3 installer uncertain; 64 usage.

### `epx sync`

Usage: `epx sync [--expect-link <linkId> | --expect-hub-key <apiKeyId>] [--overwrite-conflict [--overwrite-client <id>]] [--local-only] [--json] [--restart-codex] [--restart-app-server-only] [--child <linkId>]... [--restart-children[=app-server] | --restart-children=codex --yes]`

Synchronize client catalogs, including Aside profiles and Pi through the running server's mutation owner.

State-changing: yes. JSON mode: `payload`.

| Method | Route |
|---|---|
| POST | `/api/client-integrations/aside/sync` |
| POST | `/api/client-integrations/pi/sync` |

| Flag | Value | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `--overwrite-conflict` | boolean | Allow conflicting route materialization only for this explicit sync. |
| `--overwrite-client` | string | Restrict takeover to one client; requires --overwrite-conflict. |
| `--local-only` | boolean | Do not fan out the Home sync to linked Children. |
| `--json` | boolean | Emit the sync fan-out result as JSON. |
| `--restart-codex` | boolean | Restart the Codex app-servers and fully quit and relaunch the Codex desktop app after a catalog, cache, or changed configuration write, on macOS, Linux and Windows. |
| `--restart-app-server-only` | boolean | Restart only the Codex app-servers and leave the desktop app running; wins over --restart-codex when both are given. |
| `--restart-desktop-app` | boolean | Deprecated alias of --restart-codex. |
| `--expect-link` | string | Sync only when this machine is a connected Remote Link Child of this link id; otherwise exit 5 with nothing changed. |
| `--expect-hub-key` | string | Sync only when this machine is a hub client connected with this API key id; otherwise exit 5 with nothing changed. |
| `--child` | string | Fan out only to this link id; repeatable. Other links report not-selected. |
| `--restart-children` | string | After each selected Child's sync, restart its Codex: app-server or codex (codex needs --yes); bare means app-server. Withheld per Child while a relayed model request is in flight. |
| `--yes` | boolean | Confirms --restart-children=codex, which quits and relaunches the Codex app and ends live conversations on each selected Child. |

- The Aside refresh uses the live server; other catalog synchronization also performs local work.
- An update in flight or an unavailable update/sync mutex refuses without changes: update-in-flight, exit 7. Another sync reports sync-in-progress, exit 1.
- A current Home catalog fans out to linked Children; --child <linkId> (repeatable) limits it to those links. Fan-out requests no Codex restart on a Child unless --restart-children[=app-server|codex] is given (codex also needs --yes); the Home then skips the restart, never the sync, for a Child with a model request in flight (restart-skipped:link-active), on Windows Children, and on epx-child, and exits 6. Applying changed Home settings may restart the Child's own EasyProxy client runtime.
- After a successful Home sync, a connected Child skipped during fan-out, a failed or timed-out Child, a synced Child whose requested restart did not certainly happen (restart-skipped:*, restart-unsupported:epx-child, restart-not-run, restart-result-unknown), or an unreadable link store yields partial exit 6. Skipped connected Children and withheld restarts include an actionable hint; update an outdated epx through its owning installer, with the Desktop tray as an option for Desktop installs. Intentional skips, including client-initiated links, --local-only, not-selected (outside --child) and child-busy (a Child operation holds the Child), keep their existing exit behavior.
- --expect-link/--expect-hub-key are checked under the lock that selects the sync path. A mismatch writes nothing, never falls back to local providers, exits 5, and ends stderr with {"phase":"child_link_mismatch"|"hub_client_mismatch","reason":...}; reasons are disconnected, invalid_state, disconnect_pending, pending_operation, hub_client, link_client, other_link and other_key. Usage errors exit 2.

### `epx stop`

Usage: `epx stop [--json]`

Stop the proxy; preserve connected-client integrations, restore native Codex config for standalone owners.

State-changing: yes. JSON mode: `envelope`.

| Method | Route |
|---|---|
| GET | `/api/stop` |
| POST | `/api/stop` |

| Flag | Value | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `--json` | boolean | Emit one structured stop summary; human output moves to stderr. |

- Connected clients verify runtime preservation support before stopping; unavailable or unsupported live targets refuse without stopping the service. Proven-stopped clients remain successful when the manager is inactive.
- Siblings and connected clients preserve shared integrations. Standalone owners restore native Codex configuration and remove the managed Grok block.
- JSON uses epx-stop/1 and retains the same exit codes: 0, 1, 79 (history cleanup incomplete), 80 (teardown deferred).

### `epx telemetry status`

Usage: `epx telemetry status [--json]`

Inspect anonymous telemetry consent status and the daily payload preview.

State-changing: no. JSON mode: `payload`.

| Method | Route |
|---|---|
| GET | `/api/telemetry` |

| Flag | Value | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `--json` | boolean | Emit the telemetry status and preview as JSON. |
